_comment: The inputs the placement, leak and end-to-end gates render with. Acme is
not a real bot and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a temp
directory, asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be
AWKWARD rather than tidy — a bot name with an apostrophe and an ampersand
(both legal in the card's pattern, both special in TypeScript strings,
shell words and JSON), a hyphenated repo slug that CONTAINS this
baseline's own slug, an owner other than the baseline's, and NO
domain — a console build asks for none, so the placeholder
<reponame>.example.com is what a bot is born with — because a fixture
that only uses values the templates were written against proves the
templates work on the values they were written against.
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
